description.narrative: Ghana - Agriculture Project - Feeder Roads Activity: the Rehabilitation of Feeder Roads ("Feeder Roads Activity"): To improve transportation linkages and to reduce transport costs, MCC Funding will support the rehabilitation or upgrading of approximately 360 km of feeder roads in the Intervention Zones. In addition, MCC Funding will support the design and preparation of bidding documentation for the rehabilitation or upgrade of approximately an additional 590 km of feeder roads in the Intervention Zones. MCC Funding will support the following: (i) Rehabilitation and upgrading of the identified segments of feeder roads and (ii)Feasibility and design studies and implementation of environmental and social mitigation measures
